rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling afraid or frightened.

example.english: I feel a bit scared walking home alone at night.
example.traditional: 我一個人行夜路有啲驚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 je6 lou6 jau5 di1 geng1

rows.note: Use this when being scared also makes someone panicky or flustered.

example.english: As soon as the fire alarm rang, the whole group got scared and panicked.
example.traditional: 火警鐘一響，成班人即刻驚慌。
example.jyutping: fo2 ging2 zung1 jat1 hoeng2 seng4 baan1 jan4 zik1 hak1 geng1 fong1

rows.note: Use this for someone who is timid or easily frightened rather than for a single moment of fear.

example.english: They've always been scared of everything.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 geng1 cing1
